scope: Consonant doubling isolation with unchanged suffix rules

details: Production first dead prefix is sırrı/zannı; plain-root isolated graph fails earlier at sırr/zann.
sırrı/sırrım are flat-vocabulary protected but longer sırrımda/sırrımdaki/sırrımdakiler are OOV. All five zann forms are OOV.
Wrong replacements sırtımdakiler/sanımdakiler are recognized in production.

hak/his simple-root isolated traces also fail their doubled forms; production accepts them. Source has hakkı proper and hissi adjective entries; exact production paths not enumerated, so do not claim those entries are the sole explanation.
classification: Root alternation coverage: consonant doubling; distinct from missing locative/copula continuation. Word-level examples are not separately counted.
limits: Adding raw doubled roots is an isolating experiment only, not a safe fix: it would also accept standalone sırr/zann and must not be shipped as-is.
